    Exhausting a finite convex set by extremal points #

    Let C ⊆ H be finite convex sets of objects (for reachability along arrows) such that H contains no oriented cycle. Then H arises from C by adding one point at a time, each minimal or maximal in the new set, and every intermediate set is convex (Bretscher–Gabriel, The standard form of a representation-finite algebra, 2.7, finite case). With the extension lemmas this extends every cocycle on C to H (exists_extend_cocycle).
